newsitem.title: USA: First Union hires Carter, Niggel from Alex. Brown.
newsitem.headline: First Union hires Carter, Niggel from Alex. Brown.

text.p: First Union Capital Markets Corp , a unit of First Union Corp, said Wednesday it hired two investment bankers from Alex. Brown & Sons, a unit of Alex. Brown Inc, to lead its expanded public finance operations in Georgia, Tennessee and North and South Carolina.
Douglas Carter, former managing director for public finance at Alex Brown, becomes managing director and head of First Union's municipal finance operations in the four states.

Before joining Alex Brown in 1990, he managed First Union's public finance department and organized its entrance into the public finance sector. Carter was formerly the finance director for the City of Charlotte, N.C.
Joseph Niggel, who headed Alex Brown's Charlotte regional office, becomes vice president for First Union Capital Markets' public finance department.

At Alex Brown, which recently anounced it was exiting the public finance sector, Niggel was responsible for business development in North and South Carolina and Virginia. He previously was fiscal services manager for Prince William County, Va., and state debt manager for Virginia.
"Doug and Joe are tremendous additions to our team," said Sandy Curlett, president of First Union Capital Markets Corp. "They bring many years of experience and know issuers throughout the region."
First Union Capital Markets parent First Union is the sixth-largest bank holding company in the U.S., with $137 billion in assets.
First Union recently saw strong growth in public finance and is recruiting additional senior public finance investment bankers, Curlett said.

In March, First Union announced the hiring of Craig Hunter as managing director and head of First Union's public finance efforts in Florida. Hunter was managing director of public finance at William R. Hough & Co, the largest municipal securities firm based in Florida.
